description: This file contains automated test cases for the OrderService component in the OpenMRS project. It tests various functionalities related to orders, such as saving, retrieving, discontinuing, and frequency management, using JUnit 5. The test class extends BaseContextSensitiveTest, indicating it runs within an OpenMRS integration testing context.

classes.name: OrderServiceTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for testing the OrderService, which handles CRUD operations and business logic related to patient orders in OpenMRS.
